column4: Calls the XDATA signature checker and initializes several values if it returns carry set; the overall role is not established.

Called from stub 0x40A0. When IRAM 0x40:0x41 reaches 0x0400 it is cleared and the 32-bit countdowns at IRAM 0x6D..0x70 and 0x65..0x68 each lose 8, saturating at zero. The counter increment and its period are in unavailable ROM.

Copies flash 0xC000 into XDATA 0x3800, checks JM at 0xC0FE, HD at 0xC0E0 and BC at 0xC0F0, then copies VID/PID, USB string indexes 0xC006-0xC008, feature byte 0xC0E7, flags 0xC0F2/0xC0F3, the big-endian spin-down value at 0xC0F4 and the 0xC0F8 Temp boundary (minimum 45) into working variables.

Three NOPs follow LCALL 0x1BF0; with the next byte they form 00 00 00 3C. The surrounding code stores this inline value to XDATA 0x3218 when the loaded spin-down value is below it, i.e. a 60-unit minimum. D52 identifies an instruction at 0x4B5B; ROM helper semantics are inferred from the call pattern.
Loads XDATA 0x300F and calls unavailable 0x1C2D before a sorted target/opcode table; dispatch semantics are inferred.
36 sorted three-byte target/opcode entries, followed by 00 00 and default 0x7F59; DF entry points to 0x7D84.
Apparent DF table target; checks byte at XDATA 0x301A and forwards or processes paths including FB.
Compares XDATA 0x301A against FB; on inequality branches to the call at 0x7EE0.
On the FB path, the low nibble at XDATA 0x3010 selects calls to 0x3334, 0x330F, 0x3720 or 0x3251 for 1, 2, 3 or 7.
Calls unavailable code at 0x1488 on the non-FB path; FA reaches this path.
After comparisons with FF 04 4A 4D 55, sets bit 0x21.5 on this conditional path.
After comparisons with FF 04 4A 4D AA, clears bit 0x21.5 on this conditional path.
Compares the command-buffer bytes with E0 F4 E7 before the conditional gate rejoins the command path.
Compares the command-buffer opcode with DF on the conditional gate path.
13 sorted target/opcode entries follow LCALL 0x1C2D after loading IRAM 0x4D; default target 0x9BFB. ROM helper semantics are unknown.

Sets XDATA 0x3D78 to 0x80 when bit 0 of the 0xC0E7 working copy (XDATA 0x3215) is set, otherwise 0xC0, and chooses different power values; consistent with USB bmAttributes bus/self power and bMaxPower.
24 sorted target/opcode entries follow LCALL 0x1C2D after loading XDATA 0x300F; default target 0xAFD0. ROM helper semantics are unknown.
Writes 5A C3 69 E1 to XDATA 0x4C00..0x4C03; the range's purpose and persistence are unknown.
Compares XDATA 0x4C00..0x4C03 with 5A C3 69 E1 and returns carry clear only when all four match.
Prints == Auto-Spin-Down-HDD ==, requests state 0x1A through 0x594A and reloads IRAM 0x65..0x68 from XDATA 0x3218. Reached from 0xC29B when XDATA 0x3217 is set and the countdown is zero.
